milestones.title: The documented config-file layer actually runs

rationale: The bugfix-on-a-fixture-repo capability, probed against a defect that is genuinely present rather than planted. sampleproj/config.py::DEFAULT_CONFIG_FILENAME is defined and never read by anything, and sampleproj/config.py::resolve reaches the file layer only under if config_path is not None, so the precedence chain the project's own README publishes is not the chain the code runs. Fixing it means reading the divergence out of the documentation and the code together, not following an instruction to change a line, which is the capability worth measuring. The existing tests pass either way, so the mission cannot be steered by a red suite.
title: Find and fix a documented behaviour the code never performs
